The provider resends a webhook until it is acknowledged. The webhook-receiver puts every resent copy on provider-events, which is normal at-least-once delivery. The ledger-consumer then books a new transaction for each copy without checking whether that event_id was already posted. The payment-confirmer receives the same copies and correctly answers already_confirmed. Seven events were booked 2 or 3 times: six payment.succeeded and one refund.succeeded.
